title: Create and register a remote host
responsibility: Create a disabled host identity or register an existing identity and enable its relay connection.

inputs.name: registerRemoteHost.state
inputs.description: Existing host state whose stored keys and credential are used to build the registration request. On success, the same object is updated with enabled true, the accepted relay origin, and the response generation; the response host ID must match hostId.

inputs.name: registerRemoteHost.name
inputs.description: Computer name copied into the registration input. This function does not normalize or otherwise constrain it.

inputs.name: registerRemoteHost.register
inputs.description: Called with hostId, the stored public key, a host-bound credential hash, and name after the stored keys are imported. It must resolve to RemoteHostRegistration; callback rejections propagate.

outputs.name: remoteHostIdentity
outputs.description: A fresh disabled remote host state with generated P-256 keys, a host ID derived from the public key, a random credential, no relay origin, generation zero, and empty device and revocation lists. It is ready to register but does not call the hub or enable the host.

outputs.name: registerRemoteHost
outputs.description: The imported host key pair, returned after the registration response has an accepted relay origin and the same host ID. The accepted origin must be HTTPS or HTTP on loopback; the response generation is written to state.

errors.name: HubNoRelayError
errors.description: Rejects when key generation, key export or import, credential hashing, or the registration callback fails. A response with an invalid relay origin or a mismatched host ID throws HubNoRelayError('The hub named no relay.'); dependency and callback rejections propagate.
